title: CORS
shortDescription: Installing, deleting, and viewing the configuration of the cross-origin request (CORS) mechanism in buckets
metaDescription: All available methods for working with the configuration of the cross-origin request (CORS) mechanism in VK Object Storage buckets: get the current configuration (GetBucketCORS), set the configuration (PutBucketCORS), delete the configuration (DeleteBucketCORS)
